column1: # Returns on the divergence manifest (manifests/divergences.json): an implementer that runs an entry's case and is sure
# the kernel's verdict is wrong says so here, one row per return. Read by tools/build_divergences.py; held by
# id            the entry's id, as the manifest gives it
# implementer   who returns it (persist | edge | agent | server | client | verify | tooling)
# counter_rows  the implementer's counter-case as a JSON list of rows in the manifest's row form, or empty
# counter_ask   a JSON ask for the counter-case, or empty for the entry's own ask
# their_verdict the verdict the implementer holds the case (or the counter-case) must give
# outcome       open | ours stands | theirs stands
# changed       for theirs stands: the section whose sentence changed (CC n.n) or the model file that changed
# An open return makes the entry `disputed` and needs a row of formal/derivation/text_conflicts.tsv whose carrier names
# this repository and whose witness is the entry id. Theirs stands needs `changed`, and the entry's expect_kernel then
